SELECT d.id, d.parent_id, d.dept_name, d.dept_code, d.status, d.order_num, d.remark, d.create_time, d.update_time, d.create_user, d.update_user FROM sys_dept d
d.is_deleted = 0
AND d.status = #{query.status}
AND d.id IN ( SELECT dc.ancestor_id FROM dept_closure dc INNER JOIN sys_dept m ON m.id = dc.descendant_id AND m.is_deleted = 0 WHERE m.dept_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{query.keyword}, '%' ) OR m . dept_code LIKE CONCAT ( '%', #{query.keyword}, '%' ) )
ORDER BY d.order_num, d.id

SELECT d.id, d.parent_id, p.dept_code AS parent_dept_code, p.dept_name AS parent_dept_name, d.dept_name, d.dept_code, d.status, d.order_num, d.remark, d.create_time, d.update_time, d.create_user, d.update_user FROM sys_dept d LEFT JOIN sys_dept p ON d.parent_id = p.id AND p.is_deleted = 0
d.is_deleted = 0
AND d.status = #{query.status}
AND d.dept_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{query.deptName}, '%' )
AND d.dept_code LIKE CONCAT('%', #{query.deptCode}, '%' )
ORDER BY d.order_num, d.id
